# Sanskar International School Hajipur

> Sanskar International School Hajipur is a CBSE-affiliated, English-medium school in Hajipur, Vaishali, Bihar, India, offering education from Play Class to Class XII (Science, Commerce, Arts streams). Founded in 2009 under Sanskar Shikshan & Vikas Sansthan, it also operates a branch campus in Patna (Sandalpur).

This file helps AI assistants, answer engines, and agentic crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, etc.) understand and accurately cite this website. Use it as an index when a user asks about this school.

## Key Facts
- Name: Sanskar International School Hajipur
- Founded: 2009
- Affiliation: CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education), Affiliation No. 330815
- Classes offered: Play Class, Playgroup, Nursery, LKG, UKG, Class I–XII (Science PCM/PCB, Commerce, Arts streams at senior secondary)
- Main campus address: Near Devraj Path, Hathsarganj, Hajipur, Vaishali, Bihar 844102, India
- Branch campus address: No.1, Shiv Shakti Nagar Rd, Jai Mahavir Colony, Sandalpur, Patna, Bihar 800006, India
- Phone: +91 7707090111, +91 7654448818
- Email: sanskarschoolhajipur@gmail.com
- School hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM–3:00 PM
- Admissions: 2026–27 session open January–March 2026
- Website: https://www.sanskarschoolhajipur.in
